title: Limits on new swimming pools in West Maui
summary: Most recently, a resident suggested that new West Maui pools could mainly use captured rainwater instead of drinking water. Earlier, the Board of Water Supply and Maui Planning Commission supported the pool bill, which exempts rebuilding pools destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires from its restrictions. A council member noted that Lahaina faces rebuilding, low rainfall and a Stage 2 water shortage, so water for housing is key.
